name: General Dentistry
teaser: Comprehensive everyday dental care — cleanings, exams, fillings, and everything your smile needs to stay healthy.
overview: General dentistry is the foundation of good oral health. At Pleitez Dental Corp, our general dentistry services cover the full spectrum of everyday dental care — from routine exams and professional cleanings to fillings, extractions, and more.

Our team is known for being thorough, professional, and genuinely caring. We take the time to address your dental concerns before, during, and after every appointment — because we believe great dental care starts with great communication.

whatToExpect.title: Thorough Examination
whatToExpect.body: We perform a comprehensive oral exam including digital X-rays to evaluate the health of your teeth, gums, and jaw — catching any issues early.

whatToExpect.title: Professional Cleaning
whatToExpect.body: Our dental hygienists provide thorough professional cleanings that remove plaque and tartar buildup, polish teeth, and leave your mouth feeling fresh.

whatToExpect.title: Treatment & Follow-up
whatToExpect.body: If treatment is needed, we explain your options clearly, schedule your care, and follow up to make sure you're healing well and feeling great.

faqs.question: How often should I get a dental exam?
faqs.answer: We recommend a dental exam and cleaning every 6 months. Regular checkups help catch problems early, saving you time, discomfort, and money in the long run.

faqs.question: What if I have dental anxiety?
faqs.answer: You're not alone — and we understand. Our team is experienced at working with anxious patients. We'll go at your pace, explain everything, and make your comfort our priority.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency dental care?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you're experiencing a dental emergency, call us at (818) 718-8433. We'll do our best to accommodate urgent situations as quickly as possible.

faqs.question: Do you accept dental insurance?
faqs.answer: Please call our office at (818) 718-8433 to confirm your specific insurance plan. We work with many major providers and are happy to help you understand your benefits.
